name: complaint-system
description: Internal business operations system (V1: Complaint / Case Management) for the Shopfa jewelry business.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && (npm run dev --workspace=apps/api & npm run dev --workspace=apps/web & wait)
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=apps/api
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed --workspace=apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
